definitions.physical_unit: One physical query head, averaging log1p(relative Frobenius error) across three texts before comparisons
definitions.predictor: Unchanged f756745 v2 operand-derived score; threshold0; no kernel-specific fitting or threshold tuning
definitions.spearman: Tie-aware rank correlation; null for constant ranks or fewer than two points
definitions.sampling: Qwens exhaustive; other models independently top32 plus uniform32, overlapping heads measured once. Enriched overall result is descriptive; use random stratum for an unenriched sample.
definitions.downstream: Batch next-token teacher forcing; native GPU BF16 is the matched baseline, not CPU v2. exp(delta CE) is a batch exp-CE ratio, not streaming decoder perplexity.
definitions.causal_attribution: Scale granularity, probability representation, smoothing precision and accumulation differ together. Source differences and error correlations do not isolate individual causal contributions.

runtime.timing_note: Elapsed times size the paid run and bound cost; they are not latency or speed benchmarks.

quantization.scales: independent Q/K/V amax/448 per batch and expanded head over full N,D
quantization.descale_shape: B,Hq after GQA expansion (API requires B,Hkv)
quantization.rounding: torch FP32-to-E4M3 cast after explicit [-448,448] clamp

accumulation.qk: E4M3 GMMA with float accumulator registers
accumulation.softmax: FP32 online recurrence, exp2 with max offset8
accumulation.pv: E4M3 unnormalized exp*256 and E4M3 V GMMA; float O registers rescaled across native tiles
accumulation.normalization: FP32 pre-E4M3-cast probability sum; V descale at finalize

adapter.smoothing: external K centering in FP64 before FP32; before optional shared FWHT; V untouched
adapter.hardware: Hopper sm90 only; D multiple16, D<=256

runtime.timing_note: Elapsed times size the paid run and bound cost; they are not latency or speed benchmarks.

settings.smooth_k: true only for smooth_k and rotate_smooth_k

quantization.q: symmetric INT8, one scale per 32-token warp across head_dim
quantization.k: symmetric INT8, one scale per 64-token block across head_dim
quantization.qk_dot_accumulator: INT32 tensor-core dot product, then FP32 dequantization
quantization.v: float8_e4m3fn, one FP32 scale per batch/head/channel over sequence
quantization.p: E4M3 online-softmax numerators; native exponent offset, not uniform E4
quantization.pv_accumulation: Ada FP8 MMA FP32 accumulator (upstream describes 22 valid bits), fresh instruction buffer per 64-key tile added to FP32 running output
quantization.softmax_denominator: FP32 CUDA-core sum before E4M3 numerator rounding

transforms.gqa: consecutive KV groups expanded to query-head count before kernel
transforms.rotation: shared exact study.attention._rotate FWHT with PCG64 signs
transforms.api_rounding: prepare returns contiguous FP32; Q/K/V converted to BF16 before API; rotated Q/K incur BF16 transform-rounding absent from the emulator
transforms.native_smoothing: no external K centering; core computes k.mean over tokens with BF16 result after rotation and API rounding; fused CUDA quantizer subtracts that BF16 mean in FP32 before INT8 quantization. Emulator instead centers exact BF16 expansion in FP64 before FP32 rotation
transforms.v: no shared transform or native V smoothing; API then quantizes per channel
transforms.head_dim: 1..128; upstream pads to 64 or 128; rotation needs power of two

adapter.diagnostics: public API does not expose quantized tensors or max-code counts
